description: Pumpstationer för cykel is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Göteborgs stad. Shows municipal bike pump stations as well as private bike workshops and other places where you can pump your bike. Coverage: Göteborgs stad. The portal shows the English title as "Pumping stations for bicycles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Göteborgs stad. Its keywords include Cykel, Pump. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
